client_direction: Build a realistic path toward accessible research-support or documentation work while protecting health and daily stability.

lanes.current_purpose: Protect recovery while clarifying what low-load preparation is workable.
can_proceed_now: Use pacing and accessibility supports for bounded preparation.
remains_premature: A durable or full-time work-capacity conclusion.
lanes.review_trigger: After another bounded observation or new provider guidance.

lanes.current_purpose: Identify which workspace supports reduce strain and what remains uncertain.
can_proceed_now: Document the effect of the adaptive keyboard and reclined setup.
remains_premature: Claiming that equipment removes the underlying limitation.
lanes.review_trigger: After repeated use under comparable conditions.

lanes.current_purpose: Frame equipment and support needs for proper review.
can_proceed_now: Prepare a bounded equipment question and supporting observation.
remains_premature: Treating a discussion as approval or entitlement.
lanes.review_trigger: When the fictional counselor completes eligibility and planning review.

lanes.current_purpose: Explore low-load skill development without assuming employment readiness.
can_proceed_now: Define a small training trial with pacing and a recovery review.
remains_premature: A full course load or employment timetable.
lanes.review_trigger: After one small training trial and recovery observation.

lanes.current_purpose: Prepare questions for the proper vocational authority.
can_proceed_now: Discuss training and equipment supports after eligibility review.
remains_premature: Funding, service, eligibility, or employment claims.
lanes.review_trigger: After the fictional counselor issues an actual decision.

bridges.need_or_opportunity: Accessible equipment may reduce strain during bounded document work.
bridges.proper_authority: Fictional vocational counselor or agency after eligibility and planning review
bridges.next_bounded_action: Prepare the observation and ask what assessment or documentation is required.
bridges.dependency: No funding claim until the proper authority decides.
bridges.owner: Rowan for preparation; fictional counselor for agency decision
bridges.review_trigger: Receipt of a fictional written agency decision.

bridges.need_or_opportunity: Low-load training may build evidence without requiring immediate employment.
bridges.desired_outcome: One paced training trial with output and recovery recorded.
bridges.proper_authority: Rowan, with provider and vocational guidance where applicable
bridges.next_bounded_action: Define one small training task and a next-day recovery check.
bridges.dependency: The trial must remain within the current pacing boundary.
bridges.review_trigger: Completion of the first paced training observation.

bridges.need_or_opportunity: A stale full-time goal must be replaced with a current client-confirmed direction.
bridges.desired_outcome: A current vocational direction that does not overstate capacity.
bridges.proper_authority: Rowan defines the goal; the fictional counselor determines agency planning decisions
bridges.next_bounded_action: Confirm or revise the old goal before using it in a vocational packet.
bridges.dependency: Client confirmation is required before sharing the goal as current.
bridges.review_trigger: Client review of the synthetic pathway packet.

minimum_necessary_sharing: Share only the current goal, relevant observations, bounded questions, and explicit authority boundaries needed for the fictional vocational discussion.
next_authorized_step: Human review of the synthetic packet before any distinct-case retest.
